law_name: Copyright Act 1998 (Act No. 25 of 1998), as amended by Act No. 10 of 2011
term_of_protection: Author's life + 75 years (s. 16(1)); joint works from death of last author; collective, audiovisual and anonymous works 75 years from making/publication (s. 16(3)-(4))
moral_rights: Moral rights recognized (s. 7); economic and moral rights last for life + 75 years per Commons summary of s. 16
fair_use_exceptions: Specific exceptions: private reproduction (s. 8), research/private study (s. 8A), parliamentary/judicial proceedings (s. 8B), incidental inclusion (s. 8C), demonstration (s. 8D), quotation (s. 9), teaching (s. 10), libraries and archives (s. 11)
enforcement_body: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL)
notes: Berne since 21 Jul 2006, WTO since 10 May 2012 (Commons). WCT/WPPT status not found. Term of 75 years is from a secondary summary of the 1998-2011 text; later amendments unchecked; 2023 consolidation exists on PacLII.
